templates.title: Property Showing Record
templates.description: Record a property visit, the areas viewed, and any follow-up the visitor requested.
templates.acknowledgment: The visitor and showing host acknowledge the visit recorded above.

details.label: Areas viewed
details.hint: Rooms, units, or common areas visited

details.label: Visitor observations
details.hint: Features or conditions noted during the visit

details.label: Follow-up requested
details.hint: Questions to answer or next steps agreed

templates.title: Property Condition Report
templates.description: Document the condition of a home at move-in, move-out, or an interim inspection.
templates.acknowledgment: The resident and property representative acknowledge the observations recorded above.

details.label: Rooms and surfaces
details.hint: Identify the room and the observed condition of its floors, walls, or doors

details.label: Fixtures and appliances
details.hint: Name the fixture or appliance and describe its condition

details.label: Follow-up and photos
details.hint: Repairs to follow up on or references to photos kept with your records

templates.title: Key Handover Receipt
templates.description: Record which keys, fobs, and remotes changed hands and who received them.
templates.acknowledgment: The receiving and delivering parties acknowledge the transfer of the items listed above.

details.label: Items and quantities
details.hint: For example, two entrance keys, one mailbox key, and one garage remote

details.label: Item identifiers
details.hint: Tag or serial numbers, if applicable

details.label: Handover notes
details.hint: Condition, missing items, or arrangements made at handover
